verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents its own AI capability over user data: you can create an assistant that answers questions about proprietary data, and query compiled contexts for grounded, cited answers. This is generated answers to user questions, not proactive insights or suggestions, and the evidence does not show it surfaced inside the console. missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions, evidence of in-console (inside-the-product) delivery, depth of documentation beyond one-line claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Create an AI assistant that answers questions about your proprietary data
Compile your data into a context and query it for grounded, cited answers
Publish a no-code knowledge app from a template (public preview)
